description: Lists clinical trials recruiting now for a cancer type, from ClinicalTrials.gov, optionally near a city, state or country and filtered by a biomarker, drug or treatment keyword and by phase. Returns up to 8 trials with NCT number, phase, sponsor, the sites closest to the requested place, a registry link, a link to the full search, and a link to an OpenCancer expert who can build a trial shortlist for a specific case. Listing a trial is not an eligibility decision; only the trial team can confirm eligibility

condition.description: Cancer type or condition, e.g. "pancreatic cancer".

keyword.description: Optional biomarker, drug, or treatment, e.g. "KRAS G12C" or "CAR-T".

location.description: Optional city, state, or country, e.g. "Boston" or "Germany" (city level, not a street address).

name: find_clinical_trials
title: Find recruiting clinical trials
